title: An owed list: what I've committed to and haven't built

options.label: Yes, on the overview
options.act: Commitments ledger from picks + settled; closed by commit
options.then: Keep a ledger of what your picks commit me to, closed by commits, on the overview.

why: Every option you pick carries what it commits me to, and so does every settled item. Those become a list that stays owed until a commit closes them, shown on the overview. The "Stopped" toast would have shown up as owed for a day.
Flex's send drawer already lists "What this commits the agent to, in order". The owed list is that list, kept after you send it until a commit closes each line.
